vocabulary.definition: the state of feeling little excitement or enthusiasm, often because you've got nothing to do
vocabulary.example: She felt overwhelmed by the boredom of staying home all day.

vocabulary.definition: causing someone to lose enthusiasm or confidence
vocabulary.example: The repetitive tasks at work were demotivating for the employees.

vocabulary.definition: emotions or associations that a word may bring to mind
vocabulary.example: The word 'snake' often has negative connotations.

vocabulary.definition: activates or enriches the mind, providing interest or excitement
vocabulary.example: The art exhibition provided visual and intellectual stimulation.

vocabulary.definition: something that is new, unusual, or different
vocabulary.example: The bookstore had a section dedicated to novelty gift items.

vocabulary.definition: a positive aspect of a situation that is typically negative
vocabulary.example: The upside of the delay was that we had more time to prepare.
